body:
FluentCI 0.17.7 fixes Docker service restart readiness and port discovery.

### Fixes
- Clear previous port bindings when recreating a service container.
- Wait for every configured Docker port binding before reporting the service ready, including services with an in-container readiness probe.
- Prevent restarted services such as Redis from returning an old, unreachable dynamically allocated host port.

### Validation
- Added regression coverage for delayed Docker port discovery during initial startup and restart.
- Source formatting and whitespace checks pass. Runtime regression coverage runs in CI.

The CLI version and CLI entries in both Cargo lockfiles are synchronized at 0.17.7.
